In this role, you will define local brand positioning, run end-to-end creative campaigns, and adapt global strategy into local market success across online and offline channels. 1.Market Entry & Brand Positioning Build and refine the Vietnam brand positioning, adapting global identity into a clear, locally relevant story. Analyze target consumers, market trends, and competitors to spot clear growth opportunities in Vietnam. Define local Go-To-Market (GTM) plans, communication frameworks, and messaging tailored to local consumer habits. 2.Strategy & Brand Management Set and execute multi-channel marketing plans that directly support business revenue and brand targets. Direct commercial calendars, communication plans, and visual creative to maintain strong brand identity. Build brand awareness, consideration, and trial across social, e-commerce, performance marketing, PR, and retail pop-ups. Work closely with commercial teams to align brand messaging with sales channels and promotional plans. Monitor competitor moves and consumer trends to continuously sharpen our market position. 3.Campaign Execution & Performance Lead campaigns from concept to launch across digital, social, paid media, CRM, and offline channels. Track and evaluate performance metrics (CAC, ROAS, LTV, conversion rates) to optimize spend and ROI. Use analytics and CRM data to map customer acquisition funnels and improve performance. Plan, manage, and optimize monthly, quarterly, and annual marketing budgets. 4.Team & Operational Leadership Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing marketing team. Manage agencies, freelancers, and vendors to ensure deliverables stay on schedule and within budget. Partner with Sales, Product, and internal teams to ensure execution plans achieve overall brand targets. Requirements 1.Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field; MBA is a plus. 5–8 years of progressive marketing experience, including at least 2–3 years in a managerial or brand leadership role. Proven experience in the Beauty & Personal Care or FMCG/Cosmetics industry is strongly preferred. Prior experience supporting an international brand’s market entry or expansion into Vietnam is a strong advantage. Demonstrated track record of building brand positioning and go-to-market strategies in a new or fast-growing market. 2.Industry & Functional Expertise Deep understanding of the Vietnam beauty and personal care consumer landscape, retail environment, and ecommerce ecosystem (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop, etc.). Strong hands-on experience across multi-channel marketing execution: digital, social, e-commerce, performance marketing, PR, CRM, and offline/retail activation. Solid grounding in marketing budget planning and ROI-driven campaign optimization, with fluency in key metrics such as CAC, ROAS, LTV, and conversion rate. Experience partnering with global or regional brand teams to localize brand strategy while safeguarding brand equity and guidelines. Familiarity with agency and vendor management, from creative production to media buying. 3.Skills & Competencies Strong strategic thinking paired with hands-on execution ability – equally comfortable shaping brand strategy and managing campaign details. Data-driven mindset, with proficiency in using analytics and CRM tools to guide decisions and measure performance. Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams (Sales, Product, Commercial) and external partners. Strong leadership and people management skills, with experience building, mentoring, and growing a marketing team. Sharp creative sensibility and eye for brand storytelling, visual identity, and consumer experience. Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, including the ability to influence senior and global stakeholders. 4.Language & Other Requirements Fluent in English (spoken and written) to work directly with global/regional brand partners; fluent Vietnamese required. Willingness to travel occasionally for brand and market activities as needed. High sense of ownership, adaptability, and resilience, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Benefits Salary: Negotiable Phone allowances Full salary in probation Tet, performance bonus Premium Health Insurance Full insurance package 15 Annual Leave + 3 Sick Leave Work from home: 1 day/week Laptop provided

review_candidates.title: Mediation Support Officer
review_candidates.description: The Centre for Humanitarian Dialogue (HD) is a private diplomacy organisation founded on the principles of humanity, neutrality, impartiality and independence. Its mission is to help prevent, mitigate and resolve armed conflict through dialogue and mediation. HD operates in more than 40 countries with more than 300 staff. HD is currently looking for a: Mediation Support Officer Based in Geneva, 100% Starting date: November 2026 This position is located within the HD’s Mediation Support and Policy directorate (MESU) and specifically Mediation Guidance and Training team. It offers a unique opportunity to work in a dynamic team, supporting HD operations. Its main purpose is to strengthen hands-on support MESU provides to HD teams on the ground. In this role, you will: Provide operational support to HD teams, including through field deployments, and surge capacity with the launching of new initiatives. Ensure the development and delivery of mediation training courses and capacity building events for HD staff, partners and dialogue stakeholders. Support the Program Manager in producing guidance products. Draw lessons from HD inter-state dialogues, develop related knowledge products, foster innovation, and contribute to policy discussions in Geneva and elsewhere. Organise strategic convenings in Geneva, including high-level dialogue meetings hosted by HD and internal learning workshops to foster cross-regional learning, innovation and preparedness. Pilot the integration of Artificial Intelligence tools in HD’s mediation support approach. Represent HD in policy events, network meetings and donor briefings. Contribute to MESU-led mediation support engagements and internal events You will thrive in this role if you have: At least 5 and up to 10 years of experience in mediation support and peacebuilding, preferably with experience in a conflict-affected or post-conflict context and working directly with mediators and conflict parties. Advanced university degree in a relevant field, such as international affairs, peace and conflict studies. Experience in training design and facilitation. Experience in using AI tools for mediation support. Experience in mediation of security arrangements is an asset. Excellent English (C1 minimum); other languages are an asset (Arabic, French, Spanish). Strong writing and analytical skills. Strong organisational skills. Capacity to work autonomously while collaborating closely within a team. Adaptability and flexibility. Curiosity and ability to learn fast. The position is in Geneva. Candidates from any nationality can apply, as HD sponsors work permits. This position requires travel. Internal candidates are encouraged to apply. If you are interested in this position and meet the above criteria, please send your CV along with a short cover letter in a single PDF file to hrgeneva@hdcentre.org by 20 September 2026. Please indicate “Mediation Support Officer” in the subject line of your e-mail. HD promotes equal opportunities in employment. For more information, please visit: www.hdcentre.org.
